what: The 'MAHARASHTRA STATE MAJOR TOURIST PLACES AND TRANSPORT ROUTES' map printed below the Q6 block — a district-level outline map of Maharashtra (Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Telangana, Karnataka and Goa named around the border, Arabian Sea to the west) showing district headquarters, major places/stations, caves, forts, hot water springs, air transport centres and ports as index symbols, plus National Highways (solid pink) and Railways (dashed purple), with a north arrow and a 0-60-120 km scale bar. Needed to read the 'Hot Water Spring' symbols and name the places they sit on (e.g. Unapdev, Vajreshwari, Unakeshwar, Sav, Unhavare, Ganeshpuri area).

Same 'MAHARASHTRA STATE MAJOR TOURIST PLACES AND TRANSPORT ROUTES' map — needed to trace the National Highway and Railway lines against the plotted tourist places and pick out where transport routes and tourist development coincide.
